notes: Adds dynamic reusable Groups. Department Managers is a built-in automatic group driven by current Department Manager responsibility records. Managers/Admins can create custom groups from position titles, named people and/or whole departments. Groups are selectable in controlled-document Training audiences, standalone Training/TBT audiences and Safety Awareness audiences. Group membership changes automatically recalculate active assignments. Groups are site-scoped and every new site receives its own Department Managers group. Includes v2.11.54 cache/login recovery.
